model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 840 Front Street in Casselton, North Dakota, as the Commander Delbert Austin Olson Post Office.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Julie Fedorchak (R-ND)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility in Casselton, North Dakota, located at 840 Front Street, in honor of Commander Delbert Austin Olson.
